Then i gave the money to my cousin to count the money. She counted and gave the same back to me. Please tell me the meaning of the dream. 6038 views Q. As Salaamu Alaikum. I had a dream and would like to have it interpreted Insha Allah. I was in a house with about 5 other people both male and female, I don't think any were Muslim except for me. Something broke and 2 went to the basement to fix it, while down there, the house exploded and everyone died. In my dream we were re-created and taken back to the time before the explosion without clear memory of what was to happen. We were reading a book with stories and it became clear to me that the book was reminding me what was going to happen. I knew it was the Will of Allah SWT so I didn't fight it or try to convince other people. Instead, when I recognised the time approaching for the explosion I rushed to make wudhu & make salah as I wanted to die in a state of salah. At the time of the explosion, nothing happened. I finished my prayer and went to see the other people. One man who had gone downstairs to fix the problem(as in the beginning) smiled at me and showed me his hand which was burnt. Can you please tell me what this means? May Allah SWT reward you for your time and effort. 1609 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 32553 Country: India Title: Dream regarding preparations of marriage Question: I am still a single girl. Last night a saw a dream wherein i saw a few of my relatives asking me to show my mariiage clothes. This meant that i was getting married. I saw two ladies. 1 was my cousin with whom i am not very much attached and the other was her realtive. Here i want to inform you that last mont i had got engaged but that engagmnt was broken from boy's side becoz a past relation of mine. That engagmnt remained for 15 days only. Here i want to say one thing regarding my previous relation. I had to break that relation becoz he was from a loe caste and my family did not agree to that relation. I could have fought for that but i thougt this relation will not get the respect it deserves. so i though it is best to back off. even after my engagmnt broke, this biy is still ready to marry me but i am not ready to make any efforts becoz of the same reason. Please suggest what i should do. and suggest regarding the dream i saw. Answer ID: 32553 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1183/742/H=1432) It is nice dream. The meaning of this dream is that you should follow the advice and instruction of your parents regarding your nikah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
